title: Pull Request Inventory
description: Output of 03_extract_pulls.py. Records every pull request observed for the target repository plus the commit list, review timeline, and event timeline referenced from this artifact. Consumed by 09_compute_metrics.py for Metrics 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7. The schema enumerates every root-level field used by both (a) the hand-authored seed (network unavailable) and (b) the live extraction output. This satisfies AAP §0.9.2 (Schema-Driven Validation) for the seed-document contract while preserving the explanatory richness of the hand-authored artifact.

excluded_authors.description: Email addresses excluded from Flow Velocity per AAP §0.5.3.3 (dependency-management bots; canonical dependabot[bot] App email).

excluded_authors_note.description: Free-text justification for the excluded_authors list.

blitzy_actor_emails.description: Union of email identities treated as the single 'Blitzy' engineering actor per AAP §0.1.5.

blitzy_actor_emails_note.description: Free-text justification for the blitzy_actor_emails list.

pulls.description: Inventory of pull requests. May be empty if api_available is true but the repository has no PRs in the queried date range, or if the API is unreachable in the seed run.

items.$comment: Two PR-entry shapes are accepted: (1) full live-API shape with every field populated; (2) fallback shape produced when github_api.available is false, where certain fields that are only knowable from the live PR object (number for ad-hoc merges, created_at, draft, head.sha, base.sha, pr_commits[]) may be null, the literal placeholder 'unknown_local_git_only', or absent. The fallback shape is the one used by the CP2 seed artifact in this repository. The 'required' list is the intersection of fields that BOTH shapes carry; the per-field types are widened to permit the fallback values explicitly. The full set of fields a live-API entry would carry is documented in the per_pr_schema_documentation block at the top of pulls.json and is enforced by the live extractor (scripts/03_extract_pulls.py) when the API is reachable.

number.description: GitHub PR number. INTEGER when the merge commit references a PR via its subject line (pattern '#NNN'). NULL when this entry is an ad-hoc merge commit with no PR reference (fallback only). The live extractor produces an integer in every case.

created_at.description: PR creation timestamp. STRING (ISO-8601 Z-form) when the live PR object is available. NULL in fallback mode because PR creation time is not derivable from local-git history alone — when null, the artifact MUST carry a sibling `created_at_null_reason` field.

draft.description: PR draft flag. BOOLEAN when the live PR object is available. NULL in fallback mode because draft state is not derivable from local-git history (the `draft` boolean lives on the PR object). When null, the artifact MUST carry a sibling `draft_null_reason` field.

sha.description: Head-branch tip SHA. SHA hex when the live PR object is available; the literal placeholder string 'unknown_local_git_only' in fallback mode because the merge commit only references the merged tip via its merge-of-parent pointer, not via the head branch's true tip SHA.

Base-branch tip SHA at the moment of the PR. SHA hex when the live PR object is available; the literal placeholder string 'unknown_local_git_only' in fallback mode because the base tip at PR-creation time is not derivable from the post-merge state.

linked_linear_keys.description: Linear issue keys extracted from the PR body and title (e.g., ENG-1234). Empty array if none found.

pr_commits.description: Commit list for this PR. May be empty if the PR has no commits (rare).

pulls_note.description: Free-text note explaining the pulls[] population state (e.g., empty in the seed run vs populated post-extraction).

per_pr_schema_documentation.description: Self-documenting per-PR schema reference embedded in the artifact for downstream consumers and reviewers.

observed_merge_commits_on_main.description: Local-git fallback inventory of explicit merge commits on the default branch (extracted via `git log main --merges`). Provides a lower bound on merged-PR count when github_api.available is false.

observed_merge_commits_on_main_count.description: Authoritative count derived from observed_merge_commits_on_main[]. Cross-checked against commits.csv multi-parent count.

observed_merge_commits_on_main_note.description: Free-text justification of the local-git merge-commit count and its semantic distinction from the merged-PR count.

summary.description: Roll-up counts derived from pulls[] and observed_merge_commits_on_main[]. All zeros are valid when pulls[] is empty in the seed run.

draft_prs_count.description: Count of PRs in draft state at extraction time. INTEGER when the GitHub Pulls API was reachable and the draft flag could be observed. NULL when github_api.available is false because draft state is not derivable from local-git data alone (the `draft` boolean lives on the PR object, not on any commit or ref). When null, the artifact MUST carry a sibling `draft_prs_count_null_reason` field explaining the unavailability.

rule_compliance.description: Per-Rule (1-6) compliance attestation for this artifact, supporting AAP §0.9.1 quality gates.

metadata.description: Standard _metadata envelope shared by hand-authored seed artifacts. The inflection_date_utc field is the canonical phase-partition key referenced in every downstream metric per AAP §0.5.6, and is enforced as a required field here so the Rule-4 Internal Consistency contract is mechanically satisfied.

extraction_timestamp.description: Wall-clock UTC timestamp at which the GitHub Pulls API (or local-git fallback) was queried. Equivalent to the schema's pre-fix root-level `fetched_at` field; relocated under `_metadata` for consistency with the other seed artifacts (per_engineer.json, pulls.json, reviews.json, etc.).

run_id.description: Per-run correlation ID (UUID4) generated by 00_environment.sh and propagated via BLITZY_RUN_ID.

repository_slug.description: GitHub repository slug in 'owner/name' form. Equivalent to the schema's pre-fix root-level `repo_slug` field.

inflection_date_utc.description: Canonical AI-introduction inflection point. Module-scope constant per AAP §0.5.6: identical across inflection.json#date_utc, metrics.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc, per_engineer.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc, and pulls.json#_metadata.inflection_date_utc. Rule 4 (Internal Consistency) requires all four values to be equal.

schema_version_change_note.description: Free-text justification for the latest schema_version bump. Lets a reviewer scan recent CP-remediation changes without diffing the schema file. Required only when schema_version differs from the prior release; permitted but unused otherwise.

githubApi.description: GitHub Pulls API connection state. The `available` boolean is equivalent to the schema's pre-fix root-level `api_available` field; relocated under `github_api` so the seed file can attach the endpoint, fallback, and pagination details in a single coherent block.

available.description: True when the GitHub Pulls API responded successfully; false when 03_extract_pulls.py fell back to local-git PR reconstruction. Drives Metric 1/2/4/5/6/7 confidence downgrade from High to Medium per AAP §0.2.4.
